dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: The skill consolidates a 13‑category diagnostic tree, exact AWS CLI commands, precise property values (e.g., 30‑minute timeout, partition‑projection TBLPROPERTIES), and nuanced engine‑version differences that a generic model would not enumerate. This provides concrete expert knowledge beyond baseline capability.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: The procedure follows a senior‑engineer mindset: read‑only probes first, ordered decision‑tree, explicit pre‑flight safety checks, and AWS‑specific ordering (get‑query‑execution → glue get‑table → s3 ls). Only minor generic wording ("check permissions") prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: A thorough NEVER list is provided with concrete reasons (e.g., never assume CTAS writes to source location, never rely on MSCK REPAIR for large partitions). Only minor omission: no explicit anti‑pattern for federated catalogs or Lake Formation edge cases.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description clearly states WHAT, WHEN, and KEYWORDS. Activation triggers and invocation schema are well defined. Slight shortcoming: entry_point flag is false (though not required) and the description could better highlight limits of offline vs live diagnosis.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The skill layers information (quick start → mindset → philosophy → detailed decision tree). However, the quick‑start section packs many details, which may cause initial cognitive overload before the reader reaches deeper layers.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (DROP/CREATE, MSCK REPAIR) are gated with explicit CONFIRM prompts and safety checks. Creative tasks are not over‑constrained, matching the fragility of Athena operations.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: The skill follows a coherent, recognizable pattern (quick start, mindset, philosophy, triage table, stepwise process, anti‑patterns, safety gates, remediation, deep reference). No ad‑hoc structure detected.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a usable decision tree, concrete CLI commands, and worked examples. Some edge cases (Lake Formation permissions, multi‑catalog failures) are not fully covered, and the examples assume the operator has all required IAM context, which could limit immediate execution.
